name: John
source:
An African American transfer student visiting Japan. He thinks Japanese girls are very pretty. He wants to be in Yui's class but he's put in another and so he makes an effort to spend time with her when he can.

[spoiler]He wants to defend Yui's sister after they discover she's being blackmailed and sexually assaulted but Yui is afraid of his violence so she convinces him that rape is legal in Japan.[/spoiler]
